instruction: I have drafted my resignation email on Gmail. Attach "~/documents/work/resignation.pdf" from my file system to it and schedule it to be sent to my manager on next Monday at 9 am.
notes: Task is a pure state-change task (no answer). The draft is located via gmail.show_drafts with query 'resignation'; the manager's email comes from phone.search_contacts filtered by relationship 'manager'; file_system login is needed only to provide file_system_access_token for gmail.upload_attachments_to_draft. gmail.update_draft sets both the recipient list (email_addresses=[manager email]) and scheduled_send_at (next Monday 09:00 = 2023-05-22T09:00:00), matching the evaluation which requires exactly one updated draft (recipient_ids and scheduled_send_at) and exactly one added attachment on that draft. phone.get_current_date_and_time is modeled as a knowledge-gathering step gating the scheduling. Static facts (email-of, draft-matches, target-send-time) encode existence of entities; lookups assert known-email / known-id. supervisor-complete-task carries the task records as non-API parameters so its precondition equals the ground goal conditions; it is the only action producing (task-completed) and all others require (not (task-completed)).
